faq.q: What is the Starlite Marbella 2025 pre-concert dinner cruise?
faq.a: It's a boat charter from Puerto Banús that combines a scenic dinner cruise along the Marbella coastline with a convenient pre-concert experience. You board in the late afternoon, enjoy a meal and drinks on deck, then disembark and transfer to the Starlite venue in time for the show. It's a popular way to make the evening special.

faq.q: How long does the cruise take?
faq.a: Most guests book a 2-hour cruise, which gives you plenty of time to eat, relax, and watch the sunset before heading to the concert. If you want more time to swim or simply enjoy the boat, a 4-hour charter is also possible. The transfer from Puerto Banús to Starlite takes about 10–15 minutes by road.

faq.q: Which boats are available for a Starlite dinner cruise?
faq.a: For a pre-concert dinner, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, up to 9 guests) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, up to 11 guests) are ideal and start at €749 for 2 hours. If you're celebrating with a larger group, the Mangusta 80 (24m, up to 12 guests) is available from €4,719 for 4 hours and includes a free jet ski. Other boats are available on request.

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, and safety equipment. The Spanish IVA (21%) is also included, so the price you see is the final price. You can bring your own catering if you prefer, but we provide a solid base to start with.

faq.q: Can we eat a full dinner on board?
faq.a: Yes, you can. Many guests order from local caterers or restaurants that deliver to Puerto Banús, and we'll have the boat ready with tables and seating. Alternatively, you can keep it simple with the included snacks and drinks, then have a proper dinner after the concert. Let us know your preference when booking.

faq.q: How do we get from the boat to Starlite?
faq.a: We're based at Puerto Banús, which is about 10 minutes by car from the Starlite venue. We can arrange a private transfer for you (cost on request) or you can take a taxi. The concert typically starts in the evening, so a 2-hour cruise from 5pm to 7pm works well.

faq.q: Is the cruise suitable for large groups?
faq.a: Yes. The Mangusta 80 and other 24m yachts in our fleet accommodate up to 12 guests, making them perfect for a group of friends or a family celebration. For smaller groups, the Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 are great options. Just message us on WhatsApp with your group size and we'll recommend the best fit.

faq.q: What should we wear for a dinner cruise?
faq.a: Dress code is smart-casual – think summer evening wear. Bring a light jacket or sweater as it can get breezy on deck after sunset. If you plan to swim (on longer charters), pack a swimsuit and towel. Non-slip shoes are a good idea when moving around the boat.

data.body_html:
Starlite Marbella 2025 is one of the summer's biggest cultural events, and a pre-concert dinner cruise from Puerto Banús is the most stylish way to get there. Sail along the Costa del Sol, enjoy a meal and drinks on deck, then arrive at the venue relaxed and ready for the show. With departures from Puerto Banús – just 10 minutes from the Starlite site – this is a seamless evening out.

Why choose a pre-concert dinner cruise?

Concerts are long, loud, and often involve a fair bit of standing. A dinner cruise turns the whole evening into an experience, not just a gig. You get a private boat, a licensed skipper, and a floating restaurant with views of La Concha and the Marbella skyline. It's also a practical way to beat the traffic: instead of sitting in a car, you're relaxing on the water before the show.

Boat options for your Starlite evening

We have a range of boats departing from Puerto Banús, so you can match the boat to your group size and budget. For an intimate dinner for two, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, up to 9 guests) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, up to 11 guests) are perfect – both are priced at €749 for 2 hours, which includes everything you need.

For a larger group or a more luxurious experience, the Mangusta 80 (24m, up to 12 guests) is a showstopper. At €4,719 for a minimum of 4 hours, it includes a free jet ski – a nice pre-concert adrenaline boost. Other yachts, like the Ferretti 94 or Canados 86, are available on request via WhatsApp.

What's included in your charter

Every charter from Boat Rental Marbella includes a licensed skipper, fuel, and a selection of drinks: water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava. We also provide light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and the Spanish IVA (21%) – so the price you see is the price you pay. You're welcome to bring your own catering or order from a local restaurant for delivery to the marina.

Timing your cruise for the concert

Starlite concerts typically start in the evening, with doors opening around 8pm. A 2-hour cruise from 5pm to 7pm gives you time to enjoy the sunset, have dinner, and still arrive at the venue with time to spare. If you want to swim or linger over a longer meal, consider a 4-hour charter – the Mangusta 80 is ideal for this, as it has plenty of deck space and a jet ski for fun.

Where you'll sail

Your cruise departs from Puerto Banús, the glamorous marina known for its superyachts and designer boutiques. From there, you'll head along the coast, with views of the Golden Mile, the Sierra Blanca mountains, and La Concha peak. On a clear evening, the sunset over the Mediterranean is spectacular – a perfect backdrop for a pre-concert dinner.

How to book

Booking is simple: message us on WhatsApp with your preferred date, group size, and boat type. We'll confirm availability and send you a quote. For the fixed-price boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39, Mangusta 80), you can book directly; for other yachts, we'll tailor a package to your needs. We recommend booking at least a week in advance, especially during Starlite season.
